safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies any sensation of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states the patient denies throat closing sensation; generated facts do not mention throat closing or denial.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient feels their throat is closing is a key red-flag feature when assessing severity of possible anaphylaxis/upper-airway involvement. Omitting the explicit denial could make the presentation appear more severe than it was and influence triage/documented risk, though the patient still had breathing symptoms warranting urgent evaluation.
